import numpy as np
from scipy import stats
from sklearn.feature_selection import mutual_info_classif

MAX_DRIVERS = 5

def design(feats):
    # Identify strong candidates based on t-statistics
    strong_candidates = []
    for i, fid in enumerate(feats.ids):
        t_stat, _ = stats.ttest_ind(feats.x[feats.y==1, i], feats.x[feats.y==0, i], equal_var=False)
        if abs(t_stat) > 1.5:
            strong_candidates.append(fid)
    
    # Remove near-duplicates (correlated features)
    correlated_pairs = set()
    for i, fid1 in enumerate(feats.ids):
        for j, fid2 in enumerate(feats.ids[i+1:], i+1):
            corr_coef = np.corrcoef(feats.x[:, i], feats.x[:, j])[0,1]
            if abs(corr_coef) >= 0.6:
                correlated_pairs.add((fid1, fid2))
    
    # Build clusters of correlated features
    clusters = []
    visited = set()
    for fid1, fid2 in correlated_pairs:
        if fid1 in visited or fid2 in visited:
            continue
        cluster = {fid1, fid2}
        visited.add(fid1)
        visited.add(fid2)
        # Expand cluster by adding connected features
        changed = True
        while changed:
            changed = False
            for fid1_, fid2_ in correlated_pairs:
                if fid1_ in cluster or fid2_ in cluster:
                    if fid1_ not in cluster:
                        cluster.add(fid1_)
                        visited.add(fid1_)
                        changed = True
                    if fid2_ not in cluster:
                        cluster.add(fid2_)
                        visited.add(fid2_)
                        changed = True
        clusters.append(list(cluster))
    
    # Select representative from each cluster (prefer stronger features)
    representatives = []
    for cluster in clusters:
        # Get the strongest feature in cluster based on t-statistic
        best_fid = max(cluster, key=lambda fid: abs(stats.ttest_ind(
            feats.x[feats.y==1, feats.column(fid)], 
            feats.x[feats.y==0, feats.column(fid)], 
            equal_var=False)[0]))
        representatives.append(best_fid)
    
    # Remove representatives from strong candidates to avoid duplication
    strong_candidates = [fid for fid in strong_candidates if fid not in representatives]
    
    # Combine strong candidates and representatives
    candidates = representatives + strong_candidates
    
    # If no candidates, return empty design
    if not candidates:
        return Design(drivers=(), columns=(), products=(), loadings={})
    
    # Use mutual information to rank candidates
    mi_scores = mutual_info_classif(feats.x[:, [feats.column(fid) for fid in candidates]], feats.y)
    ranked_indices = np.argsort(mi_scores)[::-1][:MAX_DRIVERS]
    drivers = tuple(candidates[i] for i in ranked_indices)
    
    # Limit to at most 4 drivers as required
    if len(drivers) > 4:
        drivers = drivers[:4]
    
    # Include all candidates in regression
    columns = tuple(candidates)
    
    # Create product terms between top drivers (limit to prevent too many terms)
    products = []
    for i, d1 in enumerate(drivers):
        for j, d2 in enumerate(drivers[i+1:], i+1):
            products.append((d1, d2))
    
    # Limit total terms to prevent overfitting
    if len(columns) + len(products) > 12:
        # Reduce to just the drivers
        columns = drivers
        products = []
    
    # Weighted score using top feature
    loadings = {drivers[0]: 1.0} if drivers else {}
    
    return Design(drivers=drivers, columns=columns, products=products, loadings=loadings)
